rationale: Third-party bodily injury (child's broken wrist) on the policyholder's property arising from an icy walkway condition, clearly covered under homeowners liability.
claim_summary: Neighbor's nine-year-old daughter slipped and fell on policyholder's icy walkway during last week's ice storm, sustaining a broken wrist. Parents are pursuing medical bills. This is a pediatric injury requiring expedited adjuster investigation, documentation of property conditions, and medical records review.

case_facts.location: Walkway in front of policyholder's house
case_facts.description: Child slipped and fell on icy walkway during ice storm
